text:
The birds came and disappeared.

Words return to their remote dream.

Who speaks of hope? I feel cold.


Over pain and still more in joy,

—over these roses and in the rivers—

before as after over life.

In love,

at the beginning, at the end of delirium.


The fruit of the trees ceased.

In the human womb fruit abounds.

The mountain rises, collapses.

Without meaning the earth turns, turns.

The shadow remains so deep.

translation.title: The Birds Came
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the poem's cold motion from birds and words into the turning earth.
